entries.23d9bfce91ce2c4e: A business that sells and leases real estate and generates and sells electricity from renewable energy. Real estate is handled by the company and its subsidiary Taihei Fudōsan Co., Ltd., and power generation and sales are handled by its subsidiaries Ishikari Bio Energy LLC and Hirata Bio Energy LLC. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥7,206 million. The power generation facility of Ishikari Bio Energy LLC had halted commercial operation following an explosion accident, but resumed it in April 2026.
